versions.content: The function V2xM_Vdp_GetNextLongTermCertificateExpira- tionDate shall check for the currently used long-term certificate (aka. Enrolment Cre- dentials (EC)). If none was found, the function shall return E_NOT_OK. If a long-term certificate is in use, the expiration date of this certificate shall be provided through the parameter ExpirationDate and the function shall return E_OK.
